name: Randomizer (enemies + treasures)
description: Reorders the enemies you fight, and optionally shuffles which treasure each boss drops, from a seed. `level` sets how far enemies travel (0-10): 0 = none, 1 = within each chapter, 2-5 = within each book (5 = fully random within it), 6-10 = across all books (10 = fully random everywhere). Cross-book shuffles (6-10) are riskier -- see the note. Bosses keep their slots, the Book 1 tutorial is left untouched, and the same seed always produces the same game.
author: you
compat_note: If the game crashes mid-play, it's almost always the shuffle reaching too far. Cross-book levels (6-10) can place an enemy whose art/scripts aren't loaded outside its home book, and shuffling bosses (keep_bosses off) can break a boss fight -- both show up as an engine crash, often at the first boss. If that happens, drop level to 5 or lower and keep bosses in place.

param_spec.label: Seed
param_spec.help: Any text or number. Share a seed to share the exact same game.

param_spec.label: Shuffle amount (0-10)
param_spec.help: 0=none, 1=within chapter, 2-5=within book (2 stays near, 5=fully random within book), 6-10=across books (10=fully random everywhere). Higher=more random; lower keeps local difficulty.

param_spec.label: Balance moved-enemy HP (0-3)
param_spec.help: 0=off,1=gentle,2=match,3=harsh. Rescales a moved enemy's HP toward the difficulty of its new slot.

param_spec.label: Balance moved-enemy XP (0-3)
param_spec.help: 0=off,1=gentle,2=match,3=harsh. Sets a moved enemy's XP toward what the slot normally gives, with a small buff for tougher-than-usual / nerf for easier.
